# JSON export

Accepted: export is JSON only. The CLI without options and with --format json emits the item array. Remove CSV export, --csv, and --format csv. No compatibility path is needed. Preserve item names and integer quantities.

steps.prompt: Implement the accepted JSON-only export in .work/export/spec.md and update the export documentation.

rubric.description: export_items preserves arbitrary supported item names and integer quantities in a JSON array, including empty input; do not hardcode the CLI sample.
The default CLI and --format json produce the expected item array, and removed --csv and --format csv inputs no longer select CSV behavior.

Remove obsolete CSV functions, aliases, format branches, and otherwise unused compatibility implementations in involved production paths. Mentioning the removed options in useful migration documentation is allowed.
Update docs/export.md with accurate JSON usage and retain meaningful focused tests for supported export behavior.
Preserve unrelated inventory behavior and the accepted specification, complete delivery, and report actual verification rather than treating code deletion as sufficient proof.
